outcomes.title: Evidence hearing · Trace connected places before predicting travel time

outcomes.title: Mistake clinic · Control one variable in a runoff experiment
outcomes.product: a controlled runoff comparison or cause chain
outcomes.source: Review case: Rain is 40 units and infiltration 25%. How much is model runoff? Proposed answer: “10 units.”. Method note: In a simplified 20-unit rainfall trial, 60% infiltration means 12 infiltrate and 8 run off. At 30%, 6 infiltrate and 14 run off. Keep rainfall fixed to isolate infiltration's effect; the model omits storage and timing.

outcomes.title: Mistake clinic · Match a response to the flood mechanism
outcomes.source: Review case: A local drain is blocked after rain. What directly addresses that blockage? Proposed answer: “Assume a distant tidal barrier clears it.”. Method note: A tidal barrier addresses incoming high water at its protected location; it does not remove every upstream rainfall or drainage problem. Warnings help preparation, while drainage work addresses a different pathway.

outcomes.title: Mistake clinic · Choose a feasible package and explain its limits
outcomes.source: Review case: A package costs 25 + 20 + 15 tokens with a budget of 50. Is it feasible? Proposed answer: “Yes; each item individually costs less than 50.”. Method note: With 50 tokens, a 10-token warning system and 30-token storage area cost 40, leaving 10. Warnings help people respond; storage may hold water. Neither guarantees zero harm in every event.
